description.zh: 实人认证唯一标识,对应蚂蚁的verifyId
description.en: The unique identifier for identity verification, which corresponds to the verifyId of Ant.
The extended parameters, in JSON string format.

description.zh:
防伪是否通过
- PASS (通过)
- REJECT (不通过)
description.en:
Indicates whether the anti-spoofing check is passed. Valid values:
- PASS: Passed.
- REJECT: Not passed.

description.zh:
环境路由参数
- staging (预发环境)
- production (线上环境)
description.en:
The environment routing parameter. Valid values:
- staging: staging environment
- production: production environment.
